nuggets.text: The Wildcats' home, Villanova Stadium, is in its 100th year of hosting games after being dedicated on Oct. 8, 1927.
Wildcats coach Mark Ferrante is in his 10th season as head coach and his 40th year with the Villanova program.
The Wildcats and Bucknell first met in 1900 and played to a scoreless tie; Villanova has now won 10 straight in the series.
The Wildcats edged Bucknell 17-16 last week after Bucknell missed a 29-yard field goal.
Wildcats linebacker Omari Bursey leads the nation with 29 tackles through two games.
The Wildcats bring a six-game road winning streak dating back to last season into Louisville.
The Wildcats' last win over an FBS team was a 19-18 thriller over crosstown rival Temple in 2018.
Wildcats alum Matt Szczur starred on the 2009 title team, then won a World Series with the 2016 Chicago Cubs.
The Wildcats' arrival made the Patriot League a 10-team football league for the first time in its 41-year history.
The Wildcats won the 2009 FCS national title, edging Montana 23-21 in Chattanooga.
